Good except for the PIPED MUSIC!
Aug 2024 • Friends
This is an excellent restaurant in every respect except one: THE PIPED MUSIC. If it were not for the music, I would have given 5 stars for atmosphere. My visits to Bep Vo are marred by having to continually ask for the music to be turned down or, better still, turned off. The music is badly chosen and too loud. Why can't the management understand that the music adds nothing to the ambience and often interferes with conversation? If music has to be played, it should be soft and instrumental (no voices). I will continue eating at Bep Vo but will always ask for the music to be adjusted.

Vegetarian options: The veggie baguettes are excellent. So are the veggie skewers.

Great food at amazing prices
Oct 2019
I recently moved to Saigon and have already been/ordered from this place 4 times. The food is really good. A lot of Vietnamese specialities. It can also be quite healthy if you order right. They also do amazing cocktails! Myself and my girlfriend dined there one evening - we had the grilled makerale & pineapple (our fav), a beef fresh rice paper roll, and basil chicken rice stir fry. We had 1 margarita and 1 whiskey sour. The bill was just short of $12. Incredible!
